resources.string: Shows the Hush ghost on text fields. Speech stays on this phone.

Hush shows a small ghost button when you edit a text field. Tap the ghost and speak. Tap the check mark to put the text at the cursor, or tap X to stop. Hush finds the focused text field and types the text into it. Speech recognition runs on this phone. Hush does not send audio or text to a server.
Hush listens only after you tap the ghost. Speech stays on this phone.
Go to Installed apps > Hush voice typing and turn it on.
If Android shows “Restricted setting”: tap “Open apps”, tap Hush, tap ⋮ (top right), tap “Allow restricted settings”, and try again.
In app info, set Battery to Unrestricted.
On a Samsung phone, also go to Settings > Battery > Background usage limits and add Hush to “Never sleeping apps”.
Hush downloads the model one time. After that, Hush uses no network.
Tap here. The Hush ghost shows above the keyboard.
